title: Detect missing app_state metadata when persisted sessions survive
outcome: If the monolithic app_state metadata row disappears while normalized session rows survive, boot silently defaults ignored_discovered_codex_thread_ids to an empty set and can mass-import months of previously suppressed Codex threads as phantom sessions. Treat this mixed state as data loss rather than a fresh install.
acceptance: Boot cannot silently interpret missing metadata plus existing sessions as a fresh empty ignore set; recovery behavior is explicit and tested; mass discovery import has a deterministic safety policy.
